description: Fired when the user presses Save on a dirty draft. Persist event.schedule with system.user.editSchedule (or addSchedule when it does not exist yet) and refresh the data.schedules binding. Capability flags only hide UI: a crafted client can send this event with any payload, so check the session user's roles and re-read the flags here on the gateway before writing (see the adminAuth reference library). isNew is only a UI hint a crafted client can set to anything: work out whether a save creates from gateway data (system.user.getScheduleNames()).

schedule.description: The full desired schedule as the flat BasicScheduleModel mirror: name, description, observeHolidays, allDays, repeatAlternating, startingAt, and per-day <day>/<day>Time pairs with explicit 24h ranges.

isNew.description: True when this save comes from the create flow. A UI hint only, so don't decide what to write from it: work out whether the save creates from gateway data. Use it only to report a conflict instead of overwriting a schedule that already has this name.

oldName.description: Present only on a rename: the schedule's previous name. Persist by adding the new name and removing the old (see the ScheduleDemo reference script).
